name: Maps
short_desc: Maps anywhere: search, directions, transit, saved places, offline on your phone
author: Humanity Labs
description: World map out of the box; add countries or regions and your server builds detailed maps, search (Photon), directions by car, motorbike, bike and walking (Valhalla) and transit (MOTIS + official GTFS) in the background. Saved places and lists, sharing, GPS follow-me and offline areas on the phone. All open source and open data (OpenStreetMap ODbL, Protomaps).
